label: End-of-episode D2: arriving at S2 right after an unrewarded a1->S1 trial
explanation: Very sparse feature that fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), only when the reached state is S2, and essentially only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (ep_trial 90-99; zero activity before trial 80, value head in its lowest bin). Within that, it needs the previous trial to have been a1 -> S1 (common) and unrewarded (prev_reward=0 holds 97% of mass, prev_action=1 92%). Strongest activations are when the current trial again chose a1 but transitioned rarely to S2 after a run of a1/S1 trials; switching to a2 -> S2c after the a1/S1 loss gives weaker (~0.3-0.5) activations. It does not fire at S1, after rewarded trials, or after a previous a1 -> S2 rare loss. Recall is incomplete because weaker activations at ep_trial 90-94 and some other histories are missed; precision is limited by false positives with the same history that stay silent. All variables used are observed at D2 (ep_trial is a time-in-episode correlate the agent can track).
